`core/virtualization/src/main/java/com/nextvm/core/virtualization/engine/VirtualEngineService.kt`:

```kt
package com.nextvm.core.virtualization.engine

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import android.os.IBinder
import timber.log.Timber

/**
 * VirtualEngineService — Foreground service that keeps the virtual engine alive.
 *
 * Runs in the :x process alongside the BinderProvider.
 * This service ensures the virtual engine stays active even when the
 * main UI process is in the background. Guest app processes (:p0-:p9)
 * communicate through this service's process.
 *
 * Android 14+: uses foregroundServiceType="specialUse"
 */
class VirtualEngineService : Service() {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "VirtualEngineService"
        private const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1001
        private const val CHANNEL_ID = "nextvm_engine_channel"
        private const val CHANNEL_NAME = "NEXTVM Engine"

        fun start(context: Context) {
            val intent = Intent(context, VirtualEngineService::class.java)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                context.startForegroundService(intent)
            } else {
                context.startService(intent)
            }
        }

        fun stop(context: Context) {
            context.stopService(Intent(context, VirtualEngineService::class.java))
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        Timber.tag(TAG).i("VirtualEngineService created")
        createNotificationChannel()
        startForeground(NOTIFICATION_ID, buildNotification())
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("onStartCommand: flags=$flags, startId=$startId")
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        Timber.tag(TAG).i("VirtualEngineService destroyed")
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val channel = NotificationChannel(
                CHANNEL_ID,
                CHANNEL_NAME,
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            ).apply {
                description = "Keeps NEXTVM virtual engine running"
                setShowBadge(false)
            }
            val nm = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
            nm.createNotificationChannel(channel)
        }
    }

    private fun buildNotification(): Notification {
        // Create intent to open main activity when notification is tapped
        val launchIntent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
        val pendingIntent = launchIntent?.let {
            PendingIntent.getActivity(
                this, 0, it,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
            )
        }

        return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
                .setContentTitle("NEXTVM Engine")
                .setContentText("Virtual environment is running")
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_manage)
                .setOngoing(true)
                .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
                .build()
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            Notification.Builder(this)
                .setContentTitle("NEXTVM Engine")
                .setContentText("Virtual environment is running")
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_manage)
                .setOngoing(true)
                .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
                .build()
        }
    }
}
```

`core/virtualization/src/main/java/com/nextvm/core/virtualization/engine/VirtualProcessManager.kt`:

```kt
package com.nextvm.core.virtualization.engine

import com.nextvm.core.model.ProcessSlot
import com.nextvm.core.model.VirtualConstants
import timber.log.Timber

/**
 * VirtualProcessManager manages the allocation and lifecycle 
 * of virtual process slots.
 *
 * Each guest app runs in its own process slot (:p0, :p1, :p2...),
 * which maps to a set of pre-declared stub components in the manifest.
 *
 * Max slots = VirtualConstants.MAX_PROCESS_SLOTS
 */
class VirtualProcessManager(
    private val maxSlots: Int = VirtualConstants.MAX_PROCESS_SLOTS
) {
    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "VProcessManager"
    }

    // Slot index -> ProcessSlot info
    private val slots = Array(maxSlots) { index ->
        ProcessSlot(
            slotIndex = index,
            processName = ":p$index"
        )
    }

    /**
     * Allocate a free process slot for an app instance.
     *
     * @param instanceId The app instance to assign
     * @return Slot index (0+) on success, -1 if no free slots
     */
    fun allocateSlot(instanceId: String): Int {
        // Check if already allocated
        val existing = slots.indexOfFirst { it.assignedInstanceId == instanceId }
        if (existing >= 0) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).d("Slot $existing already allocated for $instanceId")
            return existing
        }

        // Find first free slot
        val freeIndex = slots.indexOfFirst { !it.isOccupied }
        if (freeIndex < 0) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e("No free process slots (max: $maxSlots)")
            return -1
        }

        slots[freeIndex] = slots[freeIndex].copy(
            assignedInstanceId = instanceId,
            isOccupied = true
        )

        Timber.tag(TAG).i("Allocated slot $freeIndex (${slots[freeIndex].processName}) for $instanceId")
        return freeIndex
    }

    /**
     * Release a process slot.
     */
    fun releaseSlot(slotIndex: Int) {
        if (slotIndex < 0 || slotIndex >= maxSlots) return
        val old = slots[slotIndex]
        slots[slotIndex] = ProcessSlot(
            slotIndex = slotIndex,
            processName = ":p$slotIndex"
        )
        Timber.tag(TAG).i("Released slot $slotIndex (was: ${old.assignedInstanceId})")
    }

    /**
     * Release a slot by instance ID.
     */
    fun releaseSlotForInstance(instanceId: String) {
        val index = slots.indexOfFirst { it.assignedInstanceId == instanceId }
        if (index >= 0) releaseSlot(index)
    }

    /**
     * Get the slot index for an instance ID.
     */
    fun getSlotForInstance(instanceId: String): Int =
        slots.indexOfFirst { it.assignedInstanceId == instanceId }

    /**
     * Get the instance ID for a slot.
     */
    fun getInstanceForSlot(slotIndex: Int): String? =
        if (slotIndex in 0 until maxSlots) slots[slotIndex].assignedInstanceId else null

    /**
     * Set the PID for a slot (when process actually starts).
     */
    fun setSlotPid(slotIndex: Int, pid: Int) {
        if (slotIndex in 0 until maxSlots) {
            slots[slotIndex] = slots[slotIndex].copy(pid = pid)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get the slot for a PID.
     */
    fun getSlotForPid(pid: Int): Int =
        slots.indexOfFirst { it.pid == pid }

    /**
     * Get count of occupied slots.
     */
    fun getOccupiedCount(): Int = slots.count { it.isOccupied }

    /**
     * Get count of free slots.
     */
    fun getFreeCount(): Int = slots.count { !it.isOccupied }

    /**
     * Get all slot info.
     */
    fun getAllSlots(): List<ProcessSlot> = slots.toList()
}
```

`core/virtualization/src/main/java/com/nextvm/core/virtualization/lifecycle/DexMemDump.kt`:

```kt
package com.nextvm.core.virtualization.lifecycle

import java.io.File
import java.io.RandomAccessFile
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/**
 * v37 (option B): dump dex images out of this process's own memory.
 *
 * The guest's payload dexes ship inside the APK with their method
 * bodies zeroed (SecNeo extraction: on disk, WelcomeClient.goMain /
 * runUnciomApp / enter / init / initConfig are NOP sleds). The shell
 * restores the real code in memory before ART executes it, so the
 * decrypted dex images should be sitting in this process's address
 * space (InMemoryDexClassLoader buffers / ART mappings). We scan
 * /proc/self/maps + /proc/self/mem for dex magic, validate each
 * candidate against the dex header, and write whole images to
 * dexmem-<pid>-<fileSize>-<hash>.dex next to the other guest
 * diagnostics. Offline, the dumped dex2 can then be disassembled to
 * read the gate logic that static analysis of the APK cannot see.
 *
 * Unicom only, once per process, two passes (+4s / +26s after bind)
 * so classes loaded late are covered by the second pass. Every
 * failure is swallowed: diagnostics must never disturb the guest.
 */
object DexMemDump {

    private val started = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val dumpedKeys = HashSet<String>()

    fun schedule(packageName: String, filesDir: File) {
        if (packageName != "com.sinovatech.unicom.ui") return
        if (!started.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        Thread {
            try {
                val pid = android.os.Process.myPid()
                val log = File(filesDir, "dexmem-$pid.log")
                Thread.sleep(4_000)
                runPass(pid, filesDir, log, "pass1(+4s)")
                Thread.sleep(22_000)
                runPass(pid, filesDir, log, "pass2(+26s)")
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                // diagnostics must never disturb the guest
            }
        }.apply { isDaemon = true; name = "nv-dexdump" }.start()
    }

    private class Region(val start: Long, val end: Long, val name: String) {
        val size: Long get() = end - start
    }

    private fun listRegions(): List<Region> {
        val out = ArrayList<Region>()
        try {
            File("/proc/self/maps").forEachLine { line ->
                try {
                    val parts = line.split(Regex("\\s+"), 6)
                    if (parts.size < 5) return@forEachLine
                    val range = parts[0].split("-")
                    if (range.size != 2) return@forEachLine
                    val start = range[0].toLong(16)
                    val end = range[1].toLong(16)
                    val perms = parts[1]
                    if (!perms.startsWith("r")) return@forEachLine
                    val name = if (parts.size >= 6) parts[5].trim() else ""
                    // Candidate homes for a decrypted dex image: anonymous
                    // mappings (heap byte[] / direct buffers / memfd-style),
                    // bracketed ART regions ([anon:dalvik-...], [heap]),
                    // memfd, or a plain .dex mapping. Device paths, .so/.oat
                    // images and the APK itself are skipped on purpose.
                    val nameOk = name.isEmpty() || name.startsWith("[") ||
                        name.contains("memfd") || name.endsWith(".dex")
                    if (!nameOk) return@forEachLine
                    if (end - start < 256L * 1024L) return@forEachLine
                    out.add(Region(start, end, name))
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    // skip malformed line
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            // no regions -> empty pass
        }
        return out
    }

    private fun u32le(b: ByteArray, off: Int): Long {
        return (b[off].toLong() and 0xff) or
            ((b[off + 1].toLong() and 0xff) shl 8) or
            ((b[off + 2].toLong() and 0xff) shl 16) or
            ((b[off + 3].toLong() and 0xff) shl 24)
    }

    /** Returns dex file_size if a valid dex header starts at b[off], else -1. */
    private fun dexFileSizeAt(b: ByteArray, off: Int, avail: Int): Long {
        if (avail - off < 112) return -1
        // magic: "dex\n" + version "035\0".."040\0"
        if (b[off] != 0x64.toByte() || b[off + 1] != 0x65.toByte() ||
            b[off + 2] != 0x78.toByte() || b[off + 3] != 0x0a.toByte()
        ) return -1
        if (b[off + 4] != 0x30.toByte() || b[off + 5] != 0x33.toByte()) return -1
        val v3 = b[off + 6]
        if (v3 < 0x35.toByte() || v3 > 0x39.toByte()) return -1
        if (b[off + 7] != 0.toByte()) return -1
        val fileSize = u32le(b, off + 32)
        if (fileSize < 1_000_000L || fileSize > 40_000_000L) return -1
        if (u32le(b, off + 36) != 0x70L) return -1 // header_size
        if (u32le(b, off + 40) != 0x12345678L) return -1 // endian_tag
        val stringIds = u32le(b, off + 56)
        if (stringIds < 1_000L || stringIds > 2_000_000L) return -1
        val classDefs = u32le(b, off + 96)
        if (classDefs < 10L || classDefs > 200_000L) return -1
        return fileSize
    }

    private fun fnv1a(b: ByteArray, len: Int): Long {
        var h = -3750763034362895579L // 0xcbf29ce484222325
        var i = 0
        while (i < len) {
            h = h xor (b[i].toLong() and 0xff)
            h *= 1099511628211L // 0x100000001b3
            i++
        }
        return h
    }

    private fun containsBytes(hay: ByteArray, needle: ByteArray): Boolean {
        if (needle.isEmpty() || hay.size < needle.size) return false
        var i = 0
        val last = hay.size - needle.size
        while (i <= last) {
            if (hay[i] == needle[0]) {
                var j = 1
                while (j < needle.size && hay[i + j] == needle[j]) j++
                if (j == needle.size) return true
            }
            i++
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun runPass(pid: Int, dir: File, log: File, tag: String) {
        val welcome = "WelcomeClient".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
        val cump = "CumpDoubleActiveManager".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("==== ").append(tag).append(" pid=").append(pid).append(" ====\n")
        var regions = 0
        var scanned = 0L
        var candidates = 0
        var written = 0
        var mem: RandomAccessFile? = null
        try {
            mem = RandomAccessFile("/proc/self/mem", "r")
            val chunk = ByteArray(4 * 1024 * 1024)
            for (region in listRegions()) {
                regions++
                try {
                    var pos = region.start
                    // Tail of the previous chunk, so a magic straddling the
                    // chunk boundary is still seen whole.
                    var carry = ByteArray(0)
                    while (pos < region.end) {
                        val want = minOf(chunk.size.toLong(), region.end - pos).toInt()
                        mem.seek(pos)
                        mem.readFully(chunk, 0, want)
                        scanned += want
                        val buf = ByteArray(carry.size + want)
                        System.arraycopy(carry, 0, buf, 0, carry.size)
                        System.arraycopy(chunk, 0, buf, carry.size, want)
                        val base = pos - carry.size
                        var i = 0
                        while (i + 112 <= buf.size) {
                            if (buf[i] == 0x64.toByte()) {
                                val fs = dexFileSizeAt(buf, i, buf.size)
                                if (fs > 0) {
                                    val addr = base + i
                                    candidates++
                                    if (addr + fs <= region.end) {
                                        val image = ByteArray(fs.toInt())
                                        mem.seek(addr)
                                        mem.readFully(image)
                                        val key = fs.toString() + "-" +
                                            java.lang.Long.toHexString(
                                                fnv1a(image, minOf(8192, image.size)))
                                        val hasW = containsBytes(image, welcome)
                                        val hasC = containsBytes(image, cump)
                                        var note = "dup"
                                        synchronized(dumpedKeys) {
                                            if (dumpedKeys.add(key)) {
                                                val outFile = File(
                                                    dir, "dexmem-$pid-$key.dex")
                                                outFile.writeBytes(image)
                                                written++
                                                note = "written " + outFile.name
                                            }
                                        }
                                        sb.append("candidate addr=0x")
                                            .append(java.lang.Long.toHexString(addr))
                                            .append(" region='").append(region.name)
                                            .append("' fileSize=").append(fs)
                                            .append(" welcome=").append(hasW)
                                            .append(" cump=").append(hasC)
                                            .append(" ").append(note).append("\n")
                                    } else {
                                        sb.append("candidate addr=0x")
                                            .append(java.lang.Long.toHexString(addr))
                                            .append(" fileSize=").append(fs)
                                            .append(" exceeds region, skipped\n")
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            i++
                        }
                        val keep = minOf(128, want)
                        carry = buf.copyOfRange(buf.size - keep, buf.size)
                        pos += want
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    // region vanished or unreadable mid-scan: move on
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            sb.append("pass aborted <").append(e.javaClass.simpleName)
                .append("> ").append(e.message).append("\n")
        } finally {
            try { mem?.close() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
        sb.append("regions=").append(regions)
            .append(" scannedMB=").append(scanned / (1024 * 1024))
            .append(" candidates=").append(candidates)
            .append(" written=").append(written).append("\n")
        try {
            log.appendText(sb.toString())
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            // diagnostics must never disturb the guest
        }
    }
}
```

`core/virtualization/src/main/java/com/nextvm/core/virtualization/lifecycle/GuestBreadcrumb.kt`:

```kt
package com.nextvm.core.virtualization.lifecycle

import timber.log.Timber
import java.io.File
import java.io.PrintWriter
import java.io.StringWriter

/**
 * v36 guest lifecycle breadcrumb (steps 2+3 of the four-step plan).
 *
 * Rationale: every prior experiment says the splash stall completes
 * silently — no crash, no second activity, no IPC. Two silent-failure
 * shapes remain untested:
 *  (2) an exception thrown inside a lifecycle step and swallowed by
 *      one of the engine's catch sites (each of which historically
 *      logged a one-line message with NO stack), aborting the step
 *      mid-flight while the framework believes it completed;
 *  (3) an init step that is simply never called (provider onCreate,
 *      FPSDK collection, ...), invisible without an ordered event log.
 *
 * GuestBreadcrumb is an ordered, timestamped, file-persisted event
 * log for ONE guest bind (all guests since v52). Events are buffered in memory
 * until the guest files dir is known (attachFile, called right after
 * the guest Application exists), then flushed and appended to
 * breadcrumb-<pid>.log next to the stackdump/hijacktrace files.
 * Every swallowed exception on a lifecycle path is recorded here
 * WITH its full stack trace. Diagnostics must never disturb the
 * guest: all entry points swallow their own failures.
 */
object GuestBreadcrumb {

    private const val TAG = "BootCrumb"
    private const val MAX_BUFFER_LINES = 4000

    @Volatile private var active = false
    @Volatile private var t0 = 0L
    @Volatile private var file: File? = null

    private val lock = Any()
    private val buffer = ArrayList<String>()

    /**
     * Begin a breadcrumb session for [packageName].
     *
     * v52: the session used to be unicom-only, which left every other
     * guest's bind completely witness-free (China Mobile's failed bind
     * produced no file at all). It now covers all guests. The call is
     * idempotent within a process: the launch hook begins the session
     * BEFORE its LoadedApk surgery and bindApplication calls begin()
     * again on entry — the second call must not wipe the buffer or
     * detach the already-attached file mid-flight.
     */
    fun begin(packageName: String) {
        var alreadyActive = false
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (active) {
                alreadyActive = true
            } else {
                active = true
                t0 = System.nanoTime()
                buffer.clear()
                file = null
            }
        }
        if (alreadyActive) {
            log("breadcrumb begin (already active, kept) pkg=$packageName")
        } else {
            // v76: anchor the relative [+ms] timeline to wall clock so
            // breadcrumb events can be ordered against logcat and the
            // startactivity trace (both wall-clock). Breadcrumb lines
            // themselves keep the relative format.
            log("breadcrumb begin pkg=$packageName pid=" + android.os.Process.myPid() +
                " wall=" + System.currentTimeMillis())
        }
    }

    /** Point the log at the guest files dir; flush buffered events. */
    fun attachFile(filesDir: File) {
        if (!active) return
        try {
            val f = File(filesDir, "breadcrumb-" + android.os.Process.myPid() + ".log")
            synchronized(lock) {
                file = f
                if (buffer.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val pending = ArrayList(buffer)
                    buffer.clear()
                    try {
                        f.appendText(pending.joinToString("\n", postfix = "\n"))
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        }
    }

    fun log(event: String) {
        if (!active) return
        try {
            val elapsedMs = if (t0 == 0L) 0L else (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1_000_000L
            val line = "[+" + elapsedMs + "ms] [" + Thread.currentThread().name +
                "] " + event
            Timber.tag(TAG).i("%s", line)
            synchronized(lock) {
                val f = file
                if (f == null) {
                    if (buffer.size < MAX_BUFFER_LINES) buffer.add(line)
                } else {
                    try {
                        f.appendText(line + "\n")
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        }
    }

    /** Record an exception WITH full stack — the anti-swallow log. */
    fun logThrowable(event: String, t: Throwable) {
        if (!active) return
        try {
            val sw = StringWriter()
            t.printStackTrace(PrintWriter(sw))
            log(event + " <" + t.javaClass.name + ": " + t.message + ">\n" +
                sw.toString().trimEnd())
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        }
    }
}
```

`core/virtualization/src/main/java/com/nextvm/core/virtualization/lifecycle/StateProbe.kt`:

```kt
package com.nextvm.core.virtualization.lifecycle

import java.io.File
import java.lang.reflect.Field
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/**
 * v38: read-only reflective state probe for the Unicom splash stall.
 *
 * Static reading of the shell-restored dex (v37 dumps) mapped the
 * whole WelcomeClient startup chain and showed the two network
 * requests are failure-tolerant (every error consumer still turns
 * its gate key), while runtime evidence says neither request ever
 * executed in the sandbox (no loopj threads ever existed). The stall
 * therefore sits in the short segment onResume -> startUp ->
 * checkYinsiDialog -> init, whose branch inputs are runtime state:
 * three SharedPreference booleans, Activity.isTaskRoot()/intent
 * shape, SoulPermission.getTopActivity(), and whether the ad
 * manager singleton was ever created. None of that is visible
 * statically, so this probe samples it reflectively, in-process,
 * at +2/+7/+15/+30s after bind.
 *
 * Strictly read-only: it never writes a guest field, never calls a
 * guest method with side effects beyond the getters the guest code
 * itself calls on this path (getTopActivity, isTaskRoot). Every step
 * is individually try/catch'd and failures are logged as data.
 * Unicom only, once per process. Output: stateprobe-<pid>.log next
 * to the other guest diagnostics.
 *
 * v42: (1) the thread census no longer calls
 * Thread.getAllStackTraces() — that suspends every thread, and in
 * launch58 this probe's +7s census collided with nv-stackdump's +8s
 * full dump (SuspendThreadByPeer timeout, ART suspend watchdog
 * SIGABRT'd the guest). Names now come from root ThreadGroup
 * enumeration, which suspends nobody; the remaining suspender
 * (nv-stackdump) serializes on [DiagSuspendGate]. (2) Each sample
 * also records the identity of ActivityManager.getService() and of
 * the IActivityManagerSingleton's mInstance: launch59 proved a
 * guest-initiated startActivity reached the real system AMS
 * unrewritten and the engine's AMS proxy never saw it, so the
 * samples show whether the proxy is installed in the guest process
 * at all, and if so from when.
 */
object DiagSuspendGate {
    /** Serializes diagnostic Thread.getAllStackTraces() calls. */
    val lock = Any()
}

object StateProbe {

    private val started = AtomicBoolean(false)

    // SecNeo H.d ciphertexts of the gate keys, copied from the
    // restored dex (WelcomeClient.startUp / .checkYinsiDialog,
    // CumpDoubleActiveManager.getDoubleActiveUrl). Decryption is
    // done by the guest's own H.d at probe time.
    private const val KEY_VIDEO_FLAG =
        "G7C8DDC19B03D9478B5319E4DE5DAD0C36891C12CB634AE26CD0F9958FBEBC4"
    private const val KEY_JIANBAN = "G4B82C613BC13BE3AF2019D"
    private const val KEY_INIT_DIRECT = "G6182C629B73FBC10EF008341"
    private const val KEY_CUMP_FLAG =
        "G44AAFB338F02840ED42FBD6DCDC1ECE24BAFF0258C07821DC526"

    // v40: WelcomeClient.enter() branch inputs, ciphertexts copied
    // from the restored dex (enter @000a guide flag via this.preference,
    // enter @0032 ad-switch string via App.getSharePreferenceUtil).
    private const val KEY_ENTER_GUIDE =
        "G6090E612B0279C2CEA0D9F45F7C2D6DE6D86"
    private const val KEY_ENTER_ADSWITCH =
        "G7C8DDC19B03D9428F61EAF45F3ECCDE87D9AC51F"

    fun schedule(packageName: String, filesDir: File) {
        if (packageName != "com.sinovatech.unicom.ui") return
        if (!started.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        Thread {
            try {
                val pid = android.os.Process.myPid()
                val log = File(filesDir, "stateprobe-$pid.log")
                val marks = listOf(
                    2_000L to "t+2s", 7_000L to "t+7s",
                    15_000L to "t+15s", 30_000L to "t+30s",
                    60_000L to "t+60s", 120_000L to "t+120s"
                )
                var elapsed = 0L
                for ((at, label) in marks) {
                    val wait = at - elapsed
                    if (wait > 0) Thread.sleep(wait)
                    elapsed = at
                    try {
                        sample(log, label)
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {
                        // one bad sample must not kill the rest
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                // diagnostics must never disturb the guest
            }
        }.apply { isDaemon = true; name = "nv-stateprobe" }.start()
    }

    private fun fieldOf(cls: Class<*>, name: String): Field {
        var c: Class<*>? = cls
        while (c != null) {
            try {
                return c.getDeclaredField(name).apply { isAccessible = true }
            } catch (_: NoSuchFieldException) {
                c = c.superclass
            }
        }
        throw NoSuchFieldException(name + " on " + cls.name)
    }

    private fun boolField(obj: Any?, cls: Class<*>, name: String): String {
        return try {
            fieldOf(cls, name).getBoolean(obj).toString()
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            "<" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">"
        }
    }

    private fun objField(obj: Any?, cls: Class<*>, name: String): Any? {
        return try {
            fieldOf(cls, name).get(obj)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun describeDisposable(d: Any?): String {
        if (d == null) return "null"
        var disposed = "?"
        try {
            disposed = d.javaClass.getMethod("isDisposed")
                .invoke(d)?.toString() ?: "?"
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            // not a Disposable-shaped object; class name is enough
        }
        return d.javaClass.name + "(disposed=" + disposed + ")"
    }

    /** v42: class name, plus JDK-proxy handler identity when proxied. */
    private fun describeAms(o: Any?): String {
        if (o == null) return "null"
        val cls = o.javaClass
        return if (java.lang.reflect.Proxy.isProxyClass(cls)) {
            val handler = try {
                java.lang.reflect.Proxy.getInvocationHandler(o)
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                null
            }
            cls.name + " handler=" + (handler?.javaClass?.name ?: "?")
        } else {
            cls.name
        }
    }

    /**
     * v42: all thread names via the root ThreadGroup. enumerate()
     * copies live Thread references without suspending any thread,
     * unlike Thread.getAllStackTraces(). The array is sized
     * generously and retried larger if it filled exactly (the only
     * case where enumerate() silently truncates).
     */
    private fun threadNamesNoSuspend(): List<String> {
        var group = Thread.currentThread().threadGroup
        while (group?.parent != null) {
            group = group.parent
        }
        if (group == null) return emptyList()
        var capacity = maxOf(64, group.activeCount() * 2 + 16)
        for (attempt in 0 until 3) {
            val arr = arrayOfNulls<Thread>(capacity)
            val n = group.enumerate(arr, true)
            if (n < capacity) {
                return arr.take(n).mapNotNull { it?.name }.sorted()
            }
            capacity *= 2
        }
        return emptyList()
    }

    private fun sample(log: File, label: String) {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("==== ").append(label).append(" ====\n")
        fun line(s: String) {
            sb.append(s).append('\n')
        }
        try {
            val atCls = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
            val at = atCls.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
            if (at == null) {
                line("ActivityThread: null")
                log.appendText(sb.toString())
                return
            }
            val app = atCls.getMethod("getApplication").invoke(at)
                as? android.app.Application
            line("Application = " + (app?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
            val guestCl = app?.javaClass?.classLoader

            // ---- v42: AMS identity in THIS (guest) process ----
            // The real AMS is an IActivityManager$Stub$Proxy; the
            // engine's replacement is a JDK dynamic proxy handled by
            // ActivityManagerProxy. launch59: the guest's own
            // startActivity bypassed the proxy entirely, so record
            // what getService() and the singleton actually hold.
            try {
                val amCls = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityManager")
                val svc = amCls.getMethod("getService").invoke(null)
                line("ams.getService = " + describeAms(svc))
                val singletonFieldName =
                    if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                        "IActivityManagerSingleton"
                    } else {
                        "gDefault"
                    }
                val sf = amCls.getDeclaredField(singletonFieldName)
                    .apply { isAccessible = true }
                val singleton = sf.get(null)
                val mf = Class.forName("android.util.Singleton")
                    .getDeclaredField("mInstance")
                    .apply { isAccessible = true }
                val inst = if (singleton == null) null else mf.get(singleton)
                line("ams.singletonInstance = " + describeAms(inst) +
                    " sameAsGetService=" + (inst != null && inst === svc))
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("ams identity: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + "> " +
                    e.message)
            }
            // ---- v43: self-test the proxy chain in THIS process ----
            // Read the ActivityManagerProxy invoke() witness, call a
            // harmless AMS method through ActivityManager.getService()
            // (the same reference guest code would use), re-read.
            // If our own call moves the counter but the counter never
            // moves between samples while the app is active, guest
            // code is not reaching AMS through this singleton at all;
            // if it does move between samples, only the startActivity
            // path bypasses (hijack execStartActivity channel).
            try {
                val witness = com.nextvm.core.binder.proxy
                    .ActivityManagerProxy
                val before = witness.invokeCount.get()
                var testResult = "svc=null"
                val amCls2 = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityManager")
                val svc2 = amCls2.getMethod("getService").invoke(null)
                if (svc2 != null) {
                    val r = svc2.javaClass
                        .getMethod("getRunningAppProcesses")
                        .invoke(svc2)
                    testResult = if (r is List<*>) {
                        "ok list size=" + r.size
                    } else {

                    }
                }
                line("ams.witness before=" + before +
                    " selfTest=getRunningAppProcesses " + testResult +
                    " after=" + witness.invokeCount.get() +
                    " lastMethod=" + witness.lastInvokeMethod)
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("ams.witness: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + "> " +
                    e.message)
            }
            try {

                line("ActivityThread.mH = " +
                    (h?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
                val instr = objField(at, atCls, "mInstrumentation")
                line("ActivityThread.mInstrumentation = " +
                    (instr?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("ActivityThread hooks: <" +
                    e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
            }

            // ---- locate the WelcomeClient instance in mActivities ----
            var welcome: Any? = null
            try {
                val actsAny = fieldOf(atCls, "mActivities").get(at)
                if (actsAny == null) {

                } else {

                            ?: continue

                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("mActivities walk: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + "> " + e.message)
            }

            // ---- WelcomeClient gate state ----
            val wc = welcome
            if (wc == null) {

            } else {

                line("WelcomeClient.isStartUp = " + boolField(wc, wcCls, "isStartUp"))
                line("WelcomeClient.hasToMain = " + boolField(wc, wcCls, "hasToMain"))
                line("WelcomeClient.isRunAPP = " + boolField(wc, wcCls, "isRunAPP"))
                line("WelcomeClient.configSuccess = " +
                    boolField(wc, wcCls, "configSuccess"))

    private fun readGateKeys(
        line: (String) -> Unit,
        pref: Any,
        guestCl: ClassLoader?
    ) {
        var decrypt: ((String) -> String)? = null
        if (guestCl != null) {
            try {
                val h = Class.forName("com.secneo.apkwrapper.H", false, guestCl)
                val d = h.getMethod("d", String::class.java)
                decrypt = { s -> d.invoke(null, s) as? String ?: s }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("H.d unavailable: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
            }
        }
        val getBool = try {
            pref.javaClass.getMethod("getBoolean", String::class.java)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
        val getStr = try {
            pref.javaClass.getMethod("getString", String::class.java)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
        fun key(ct: String): String = try {
            decrypt?.invoke(ct) ?: ct
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            ct + " <decrypt " + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">"
        }
        fun boolKey(labelName: String, ct: String) {
            val k = key(ct)
            val v = try {
                getBool?.invoke(pref, k)?.toString() ?: "<no method>"
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                val cause = (e as? java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException)
                    ?.targetException ?: e
                "<" + cause.javaClass.simpleName + ">"
            }
            line("pref[$labelName] key='" + k + "' = " + v)
        }
        boolKey("K0-videoFlag", KEY_VIDEO_FLAG)
        boolKey("keyA-jianban", KEY_JIANBAN)
        boolKey("keyB-initDirect", KEY_INIT_DIRECT)
        val k = key(KEY_CUMP_FLAG)
        val v = try {
            getStr?.invoke(pref, k)?.toString() ?: "<no method>"
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            val cause = (e as? java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException)
                ?.targetException ?: e
            "<" + cause.javaClass.simpleName + ">"
        }
        line("pref[cumpFlag] key='" + k + "' = '" + v + "'")
        // v40: enter()'s two branch inputs
        boolKey("enterGuideFlag", KEY_ENTER_GUIDE)
        val k2 = key(KEY_ENTER_ADSWITCH)
        val v2 = try {
            getStr?.invoke(pref, k2)?.toString() ?: "<no method>"
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            val cause = (e as? java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException)
                ?.targetException ?: e
            "<" + cause.javaClass.simpleName + ">"
        }
        line("pref[enterAdSwitch] key='" + k2 + "' = '" + v2 + "'")
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.nextvm.core.virtualization.lifecycle

import android.app.Application
import android.app.Instrumentation
import android.content.ContentProvider
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.content.pm.ProviderInfo
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import com.nextvm.core.common.AndroidCompat
import com.nextvm.core.common.findField
import com.nextvm.core.common.findMethod
import com.nextvm.core.common.runSafe
import com.nextvm.core.binder.proxy.ActivityManagerProxy
import com.nextvm.core.hook.NativeHookBridge
import timber.log.Timber
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

/**
 * VirtualApplicationManager — Manages guest app Application lifecycle.
 *
 * This is the MOST critical missing piece. It handles:
 * - Instantiating guest app's custom Application subclass via DexClassLoader
 * - Calling Application.attachBaseContext(virtualContext)
 * - Calling Application.onCreate()
 * - Managing Application lifecycle per guest app instance
 * - ContentProvider auto-init (AndroidX Startup, WorkManager, Firebase via ContentProvider.onCreate())
 * - AppComponentFactory support (Android 9+)
 * - handleBindApplication() mirror — simulating what real Android does when binding an app
 *
 * Mirrors the flow from:
 *   ActivityThread.handleBindApplication() in frameworks/base/core/java/android/app/ActivityThread.java
 *
 * Flow:
 *   1. Create LoadedApk equivalent (set up ClassLoader, Resources)
 *   2. Create AppComponentFactory (Android 9+)
 *   3. Instantiate Application class
 *   4. Install ContentProviders (BEFORE Application.onCreate)
 *   5. Call Application.attachBaseContext()
 *   6. Call Application.onCreate()
 */
@Singleton
class VirtualApplicationManager @Inject constructor(
    private val resourceManager: VirtualResourceManager
) {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "VAppLifecycle"
    }

    private var initialized = false
    private lateinit var appContext: android.content.Context

    fun initialize(context: android.content.Context) {
        if (initialized) return
        appContext = context.applicationContext
        initialized = true
        Timber.tag(TAG).i("VirtualApplicationManager initialized — Application lifecycle ready")
    }

    /**
     * Holds state for a living guest Application.
     */
    data class ApplicationRecord(
        val instanceId: String,
        val packageName: String,
        val application: Application,
        val classLoader: ClassLoader,
        val applicationClassName: String?,
        val contentProviders: MutableList<ContentProvider> = mutableListOf(),
        val startTime: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        var state: ApplicationState = ApplicationState.CREATED
    )

    enum class ApplicationState {
        CREATED,
        ATTACHED,
        PROVIDERS_INSTALLED,
        RUNNING,
        TERMINATED
    }

    // instanceId -> ApplicationRecord
    private val applications = ConcurrentHashMap<String, ApplicationRecord>()

    /**
     * Full bind-application flow — mirrors ActivityThread.handleBindApplication().
     *
     * Order (from real Android source):
     *   1. Set up ApplicationInfo
     *   2. Create ClassLoader (already done by VirtualEngine)
     *   3. Set up Resources (handled by VirtualResourceManager)
     *   4. Create Instrumentation
     *   5. Create Application instance via AppComponentFactory or reflection
     *   6. Install ContentProviders (BEFORE onCreate!)
     *   7. Call Instrumentation.callApplicationOnCreate()
     *
     * @param instanceId Unique instance identifier
     * @param packageName Guest app package name
     * @param applicationClassName Fully qualified Application class (null = android.app.Application)
     * @param apkPath Path to the guest APK
     * @param classLoader DexClassLoader for the guest app
     * @param virtualContext Sandboxed context wrapping the guest identity
     * @param providerNames List of ContentProvider class names to initialize
     * @param providerAuthorities Map of provider class name -> authority string
     * @return The created Application or null on failure
     */
    fun bindApplication(
        instanceId: String,
        packageName: String,
        applicationClassName: String?,
        apkPath: String,
        classLoader: ClassLoader,
        virtualContext: Context,
        providerNames: List<String> = emptyList(),
        providerAuthorities: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
        providerMetaData: Map<String, Bundle> = emptyMap(),
        frameworkLoadedApk: Any? = null
    ): Application? {
        // Check if already bound
        val existing = applications[instanceId]
        if (existing != null && existing.state != ApplicationState.TERMINATED) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).d("Application already bound for $instanceId, returning existing")
            return existing.application
        }

        Timber.tag(TAG).i("bindApplication: $packageName ($instanceId)")
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("  applicationClass: ${applicationClassName ?: "android.app.Application"}")
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("  providers: ${providerNames.size}")
        GuestBreadcrumb.begin(packageName)
        GuestBreadcrumb.log("bind start instance=$instanceId appClass=" +
            (applicationClassName ?: "android.app.Application") +
            " providers=" + providerNames.size +
            " frameworkLoadedApk=" + (frameworkLoadedApk != null))
        // v47: start the WebView witness HERE, at bind entry — v46
        // started it at bind complete and missed the guest startup
        // band where the early WebView touch lives (fork+1.3s).
        // virtualContext.filesDir is the guest files dir. The
        // bind-complete schedule() calls below become no-ops.
        WebViewWatch.schedule(packageName, virtualContext.filesDir)

        var legacyPrevInstr: Instrumentation? = null
        try {
            // B2: framework-native bind — when a framework LoadedApk is
            // available for this guest, the Application is created and
            // attached by the framework itself instead of being
            // hand-assembled onto the host's (patched) LoadedApk.
            if (frameworkLoadedApk != null) {
                val fwApp = bindViaFrameworkLoadedApk(
                    instanceId = instanceId,
                    packageName = packageName,
                    loadedApk = frameworkLoadedApk,
                    virtualContext = virtualContext,
                    providerNames = providerNames,
                    providerAuthorities = providerAuthorities,
                    providerMetaData = providerMetaData
                )
                if (fwApp != null) {
                    GuestBreadcrumb.attachFile(fwApp.filesDir)
                    registerBreadcrumbCallbacks(fwApp)
                    GuestBreadcrumb.log("bind complete (framework path)")
                    scheduleGuestStackDumps(packageName)
                    scheduleHijackTrace(packageName)
                    DexMemDump.schedule(packageName, fwApp.filesDir)
                    StateProbe.schedule(packageName, fwApp.filesDir)
                    WebViewWatch.schedule(packageName, fwApp.filesDir)
                    WebViewWarmup.schedule(packageName, fwApp.filesDir)
                    return fwApp
                }
                GuestBreadcrumb.log("framework path returned null, falling back to legacy bind")
                // fall through to the legacy bind path
            }

            // Step 1: Prepare ApplicationInfo on the virtual context
            val appInfo = buildApplicationInfo(packageName, apkPath, virtualContext)

            // Step 2: Create Application instance
            val application = createApplication(
                instanceId = instanceId,
                packageName = packageName,
                applicationClassName = applicationClassName,
                classLoader = classLoader,
                virtualContext = virtualContext,
                appInfo = appInfo
            ) ?: return null

            // Step 3: Create ApplicationRecord
            val record = ApplicationRecord(
                instanceId = instanceId,
                packageName = packageName,
                application = application,
                classLoader = classLoader,
                applicationClassName = applicationClassName
            )
            applications[instanceId] = record

            // Step 3.5: Set the guest Application on VirtualContext so that
            // getApplicationContext() returns the real Application instance.
            // This is CRITICAL for AndroidX libraries (ProcessLifecycleInitializer,
            // WorkManager, Firebase) which cast getApplicationContext() to Application.
            if (virtualContext is com.nextvm.core.sandbox.VirtualContext) {
                virtualContext.setGuestApplication(application)
            }

            // Step 4: Attach base context
            // v35: same stock-init cover as the framework path —
            // hijack's initailise runs inside this attach.
            legacyPrevInstr = swapInStockInstrumentation(packageName)
            GuestBreadcrumb.log("legacy attachBaseContext enter")
            attachBaseContext(application, virtualContext)
            GuestBreadcrumb.log("legacy attachBaseContext exit")
            record.state = ApplicationState.ATTACHED
            Timber.tag(TAG).d("Application.attachBaseContext() complete")

            // Step 4.5: Patch LoadedApk.mApplication to the guest Application.
            // ContextImpl.getApplicationContext() returns LoadedApk.getApplication()
            // which normally returns the HOST Application. By patching mApplication,
            // even code that bypasses our ContextWrapper chain (e.g., framework-internal
            // calls to ContextImpl directly) will get the guest Application.
            patchLoadedApkApplication(virtualContext, application)

            // Step 5: Install ContentProviders BEFORE Application.onCreate()
            // This is critical — AndroidX Startup, WorkManager, Firebase all use
            // ContentProviders that must be initialized before the Application.
            if (providerNames.isNotEmpty()) {
                initContentProviders(
                    instanceId = instanceId,
                    providers = providerNames,
                    authorities = providerAuthorities,
                    classLoader = classLoader,
                    virtualContext = virtualContext,
                    application = application,
                    providerMetaData = providerMetaData
                )
                record.state = ApplicationState.PROVIDERS_INSTALLED
                Timber.tag(TAG).d("ContentProviders installed: ${providerNames.size}")
            }

            // Step 6: Call Application.onCreate()
            callApplicationOnCreate(application)
            record.state = ApplicationState.RUNNING
            Timber.tag(TAG).i("Application.onCreate() complete for $packageName")
            restoreInstrumentation(legacyPrevInstr)

            GuestBreadcrumb.attachFile(application.filesDir)
            registerBreadcrumbCallbacks(application)
            GuestBreadcrumb.log("bind complete (legacy path)")
            scheduleGuestStackDumps(packageName)
            scheduleHijackTrace(packageName)
            DexMemDump.schedule(packageName, application.filesDir)
            StateProbe.schedule(packageName, application.filesDir)
            WebViewWatch.schedule(packageName, application.filesDir)
            WebViewWarmup.schedule(packageName, application.filesDir)
            return application

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            restoreInstrumentation(legacyPrevInstr)
            GuestBreadcrumb.logThrowable("bind FAILED (legacy/framework outer catch)", e)
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Failed to bind application for $packageName ($instanceId)")
            applications.remove(instanceId)
            return null
        }
    }

    /**
     * v36 step 3: engine-side ActivityLifecycleCallbacks on the guest
     * Application — an activity breadcrumb independent of the
     * instrumentation chain (created/started/resumed/... per activity).
     */
    private fun registerBreadcrumbCallbacks(app: Application) {
        try {
            app.registerActivityLifecycleCallbacks(
                object : Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks {
                    override fun onActivityCreated(
                        a: android.app.Activity, b: android.os.Bundle?
                    ) = GuestBreadcrumb.log("cb onActivityCreated " + a.javaClass.name)

                    override fun onActivityStarted(a: android.app.Activity) =
                        GuestBreadcrumb.log("cb onActivityStarted " + a.javaClass.name)

                    override fun onActivityResumed(a: android.app.Activity) =
                        GuestBreadcrumb.log("cb onActivityResumed " + a.javaClass.name)

                    override fun onActivityPaused(a: android.app.Activity) =
                        GuestBreadcrumb.log("cb onActivityPaused " + a.javaClass.name)

                    override fun onActivityStopped(a: android.app.Activity) =
                        GuestBreadcrumb.log("cb onActivityStopped " + a.javaClass.name)

                    override fun onActivitySaveInstanceState(
                        a: android.app.Activity, b: android.os.Bundle
                    ) = GuestBreadcrumb.log("cb onActivitySaveInstanceState " + a.javaClass.name)

                    override fun onActivityDestroyed(a: android.app.Activity) =
                        GuestBreadcrumb.log("cb onActivityDestroyed " + a.javaClass.name)
                })
            GuestBreadcrumb.log("engine breadcrumb callbacks registered on " + app.javaClass.name)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            GuestBreadcrumb.logThrowable("register breadcrumb callbacks FAILED", e)
        }
    }

    // ==================== Guest stack diagnostics ====================
    // One-shot per process: after a guest Application binds, dump all
    // thread stacks (+ the main Looper's pending messages) at
    // +0.3/+0.7/+1.2/+2/+3/+8/+20s into a stackdump-<pid>.log under the
    // Application's filesDir (for a framework-bound guest that resolves
    // to the guest sandbox files dir; readable via run-as).
    // Exists to answer "the guest UI is up but never advances — what
    // is it waiting on?" with the actual Java frames instead of
    // black-box guessing.

    @Volatile private var stackDumpsScheduled = false

    // v68: which guest the scheduled dumps belong to (drives the
    // late-marks extension inside the dumper thread).
    @Volatile private var stackDumpPackageName: String? = null

    private fun scheduleGuestStackDumps(packageName: String) {
        if (stackDumpsScheduled) return
        stackDumpsScheduled = true
        stackDumpPackageName = packageName
        Thread {
            try {
                val hostApp = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
                    .getMethod("currentApplication").invoke(null)
                    as? android.app.Application ?: return@Thread
                val out = java.io.File(
                    hostApp.filesDir, "stackdump-${android.os.Process.myPid()}.log"
                )
                // Cadence (v29): logcat comparison against a real
                // device localized the guest's init-pipeline stall to
                // the first ~1.5s after process start (bind lands at
                // ~+0.45s), so sample densely across bind+0.3..+3s
                // to catch threads mid-flight at the stall moment;
                // +8s/+20s remain as steady-state anchors.
                val baseMarks = listOf(
                    300L to "t+0.3s",
                    700L to "t+0.7s",
                    1_200L to "t+1.2s",
                    2_000L to "t+2s",
                    3_000L to "t+3s",
                    8_000L to "t+8s",
                    20_000L to "t+20s"
                )
                // v68: China Mobile's post-Agree stall sits INSIDE
                // ZWRisk.setup's native enumeration (launch90: main
                // RUNNABLE in Feinnhap.v at both t+8s and t+20s,
                // hundreds of supervisor-served readlinkat/fstatat
                // calls). Late marks answer the one open question —
                // guest-slow-but-finite vs never-returns — and show
                // what main does if setup ever completes.
                val marks = if (stackDumpPackageName ==
                    "com.greenpoint.android.mc10086.activity") {
                    baseMarks + listOf(
                        40_000L to "t+40s",
                        80_000L to "t+80s",
                        160_000L to "t+160s"
                    )
                } else {
                    baseMarks
                }
                var elapsed = 0L
                for ((at, label) in marks) {
                    val wait = at - elapsed
                    if (wait > 0) Thread.sleep(wait)
                    elapsed = at
                    dumpGuestStacks(out, label)
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                // diagnostics must never disturb the guest
            }
        }.apply { isDaemon = true; name = "nv-stackdump" }.start()
    }

    private fun dumpGuestStacks(out: java.io.File, label: String) {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("==== ").append(label).append(" ====\n")
        // Main Looper pending messages first: a scheduled-but-never-
        // fired navigation message (or an empty queue) is the fastest
        // discriminator for splash stalls.
        try {
            val queue = android.os.Looper.getMainLooper().queue
            val mf = queue.javaClass.getDeclaredField("mMessages")
            mf.isAccessible = true
            var msg = mf.get(queue)
            var n = 0
            sb.append("main looper queue:\n")
            while (msg != null && n < 20) {
                val cls = msg.javaClass
                val whenF = cls.getDeclaredField("when").apply { isAccessible = true }
                val cbF = cls.getDeclaredField("callback").apply { isAccessible = true }
                val tgtF = cls.getDeclaredField("target").apply { isAccessible = true }
                val whatF = cls.getDeclaredField("what").apply { isAccessible = true }
                val nextF = cls.getDeclaredField("next").apply { isAccessible = true }
                sb.append("  when=+").append(
                    (whenF.getLong(msg) - android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis()) / 1000.0
                ).append("s what=").append(whatF.getInt(msg))
                    .append(" callback=").append(cbF.get(msg)?.javaClass?.name)
                    .append(" target=").append(tgtF.get(msg)?.javaClass?.name)
                    .append('\n')
                msg = nextF.get(msg)
                n++
            }
            if (n == 0) sb.append("  (empty)\n")
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            sb.append("main looper queue: <").append(e.javaClass.simpleName).append(">\n")
        }
        // v42: serialize the suspension on DiagSuspendGate.
        // getAllStackTraces() suspends every thread; in launch58
        // this dump (+8s) and StateProbe's census (+7s) suspended
        // concurrently and ART's suspend watchdog aborted the guest
        // (SuspendThreadByPeer timeout). StateProbe no longer
        // suspends at all; this gate keeps any future diagnostic
        // suspender from overlapping this one.
        val traces = synchronized(DiagSuspendGate.lock) {
            Thread.getAllStackTraces()
        }
        // Main thread first, then the rest (Rx/pool/player threads are
        // the interesting waiters).
        val ordered = traces.keys.sortedWith(
            compareBy({ if (it.name == "main") 0 else 1 }, { it.name })
        )
        for (t in ordered) {
            sb.append("--- \"").append(t.name).append("\" ").append(t.state).append('\n')
            val frames = traces[t] ?: continue
            for ((i, f) in frames.withIndex()) {
                if (i >= 30) break
                sb.append("    at ").append(f.toString()).append('\n')
            }
        }
        try {
            out.appendText(sb.toString())
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        }
    }

    // ==================== Hijack SDK completion trace (v33) ====================
    // v34 adds the discriminating experiment: after each sample, if
    // ActivityThread.mInstrumentation is hijack's ProxyInstrumentation,
    // swap it (and every existing Activity's mInstrumentation) back to
    // the proxy's oriInstrumentation (the engine's NextVmInstrumentation).
    // v33 proved the proxy sits in its "hijack suspected" state
    // permanently in the sandbox (oriClassType=0); if the splash then
    // advances to MainActivity, the proxy's extracted callbacks were
    // the gate. If nothing changes, the hijack line is closed.
    // One-shot per process, unicom only. Static analysis showed the
    // guest's App.attachBaseContext() calls
    // com.sdk.hijack.api.HijackSDK.initailise(Application) first thing,
    // which (a) sets hidden-API exemptions via reflection, (b) wraps
    // ActivityThread.mInstrumentation in its ProxyInstrumentation,
    // (c) registers ActivityLifecycleCallbacks, then sets its own
    // isRegisterActivityLifecycleCallbacks flag as the last step.
    // Whether all of that actually completes inside the sandbox is
    // invisible from outside (registerContext swallows failures), so
    // at +1/+4/+12s after bind we reflectively read back the end
    // state: the flag, ProxyInstrumentation.instance, the live
    // ActivityThread/Application instrumentation objects, the
    // registered lifecycle callbacks, and each running Activity's
    // mInstrumentation. Log tag "HijackTrace" + a
    // hijacktrace-<pid>.log next to the stackdumps.

    @Volatile private var hijackTraceScheduled = false

    // ==================== v35: stock-init experiment ====================
    // v34 only removed the hijack proxy AFTER bind; it never changed
    // what the proxy wrapped. On a real device ActivityThread's
    // instrumentation is a stock android.app.Instrumentation, so
    // hijack's ProxyInstrumentation classifies its ori as type 1
    // ("not hijacked"). In the sandbox it wraps the engine's
    // NextVmInstrumentation (type 0) and any verdict latched at
    // ProxyInstrumentation.<init> / register time — during
    // App.attachBaseContext, long before any post-bind unwrap — is
    // already fixed. v35 therefore swaps a stock Instrumentation into
    // ActivityThread.mInstrumentation for the whole guest early-init
    // window (attachBaseContext -> ContentProviders ->
    // Application.onCreate) and restores the previous instance
    // afterwards: NextVmInstrumentation is load-bearing for activity
    // creation (newActivity classloader resolution, pre-create
    // injection), so it cannot stay replaced — but the classification
    // moment and everything guest init reads from ActivityThread see
    // the faithful real-device configuration. Validity check built
    // in: at restore time AT is expected to hold hijack's
    // ProxyInstrumentation (registerContext wrapped the stock
    // instance); the sampler then reads oriInstrumentation /
    // oriClassType from ProxyInstrumentation.instance — expect
    // android.app.Instrumentation / 1 (v33/v34 read
    // NextVmInstrumentation / 0). Unicom only.

    @Volatile private var stockInitExperiment = false
    @Volatile private var stockInitNote = "not-run"

    // v36: both discriminating mutations are concluded experiments
    // (v34 unwrap: falsified launch50; v35 stock-init: falsified
    // launch52). v36 is observe-only — a clean baseline plus the
    // breadcrumb — so both default OFF. Flip the const to re-run one.
    private val STOCK_INIT_ENABLED = false
    private val UNWRAP_ENABLED = false

    private fun swapInStockInstrumentation(packageName: String): Instrumentation? {
        if (!STOCK_INIT_ENABLED) {
            stockInitNote = "disabled (v36 observe-only baseline)"
            return null
        }
        if (packageName != "com.sinovatech.unicom.ui") return null
        return try {
            val atCls = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
            val at = atCls.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
                ?: return null
            val f = fieldOf(atCls, "mInstrumentation")
            val prev = f.get(at) as? Instrumentation
            f.set(at, Instrumentation())
            stockInitExperiment = true
            stockInitNote = "swapped prev=" + (prev?.javaClass?.name ?: "null") +
                " -> android.app.Instrumentation (stock)"
            Timber.tag("HijackTrace").i("v35 stock-init: %s", stockInitNote)
            prev
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            stockInitNote = "swap FAILED <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + "> " + e.message
            Timber.tag("HijackTrace").w("v35 stock-init: %s", stockInitNote)
            null
        }
    }

    private fun restoreInstrumentation(prev: Instrumentation?) {
        if (prev == null) return
        try {
            val atCls = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
            val at = atCls.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
                ?: return
            val f = fieldOf(atCls, "mInstrumentation")
            val during = f.get(at)
            f.set(at, prev)
            stockInitNote += "; at restore AT was " +
                (during?.javaClass?.name ?: "null") + ", prev restored"
            Timber.tag("HijackTrace").i(
                "v35 stock-init restore: AT during init=%s",
                during?.javaClass?.name)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            stockInitNote += "; restore FAILED <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">"
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleHijackTrace(packageName: String) {
        if (packageName != "com.sinovatech.unicom.ui") return
        if (hijackTraceScheduled) return
        hijackTraceScheduled = true
        Thread {
            try {
                val hostApp = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
                    .getMethod("currentApplication").invoke(null)
                    as? android.app.Application ?: return@Thread
                val out = java.io.File(
                    hostApp.filesDir, "hijacktrace-${android.os.Process.myPid()}.log"
                )
                val marks = listOf(
                    1_000L to "t+1s", 4_000L to "t+4s",
                    12_000L to "t+12s", 25_000L to "t+25s"
                )
                var elapsed = 0L
                for ((at, label) in marks) {
                    val wait = at - elapsed
                    if (wait > 0) Thread.sleep(wait)
                    elapsed = at
                    sampleHijackState(out, label)
                    unwrapHijackProxy(out, label)
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                // diagnostics must never disturb the guest
            }
        }.apply { isDaemon = true; name = "nv-hijacktrace" }.start()
    }

    private fun fieldOf(cls: Class<*>, name: String): java.lang.reflect.Field {
        var c: Class<*>? = cls
        while (c != null) {
            try {
                return c.getDeclaredField(name).apply { isAccessible = true }
            } catch (_: NoSuchFieldException) {
                c = c.superclass
            }
        }
        throw NoSuchFieldException(name + " on " + cls.name)
    }

    private fun sampleHijackState(out: java.io.File, label: String) {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("==== ").append(label).append(" ====\n")
        fun line(s: String) {
            sb.append(s).append('\n')
            Timber.tag("HijackTrace").i("%s %s", label, s)
        }
        try {
            val atCls = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
            val at = atCls.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
            if (at == null) {
                line("ActivityThread: null")
                out.appendText(sb.toString())
                return
            }
            // (b) live ActivityThread instrumentation
            val atInstr = fieldOf(atCls, "mInstrumentation").get(at)
            line("ActivityThread.mInstrumentation = " + (atInstr?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
            line("v35 stock-init: " + stockInitNote)
            // guest Application + its classloader (loads the SDK classes)
            val app = atCls.getMethod("getApplication").invoke(at)
                as? android.app.Application
            line("Application = " + (app?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
            val guestCl = app?.javaClass?.classLoader
            // (c) registered lifecycle callbacks on the Application
            if (app != null) {
                try {
                    val cbs = fieldOf(Class.forName("android.app.Application"),
                        "mActivityLifecycleCallbacks").get(app) as? java.util.ArrayList<*>
                    if (cbs == null) {
                        line("lifecycleCallbacks = null")
                    } else {
                        line("lifecycleCallbacks.size = " + cbs.size)
                        for (cb in cbs) line("  cb: " + (cb?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
                    }
                } catch (e: Throwable) {
                    line("lifecycleCallbacks: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
                }
            }
            // SDK end-state statics, read through the guest classloader
            if (guestCl != null) {
                try {
                    val sdk = Class.forName("com.sdk.hijack.api.HijackSDK", false, guestCl)
                    val done = fieldOf(sdk, "isRegisterActivityLifecycleCallbacks")
                        .getBoolean(null)
                    line("HijackSDK.isRegisterActivityLifecycleCallbacks = " + done)
                } catch (e: Throwable) {
                    line("HijackSDK flag: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
                }
                try {
                    val pi = Class.forName(
                        "com.sdk.hijack.base.ProxyInstrumentation", false, guestCl)
                    val inst = fieldOf(pi, "instance").get(null)
                    line("ProxyInstrumentation.instance = " +
                        (if (inst == null) "null" else "set(sameAsAT=" + (inst === atInstr) + ")"))
                    if (inst != null) {
                        try {
                            val ori = fieldOf(pi, "oriInstrumentation").get(inst)
                            val typ = fieldOf(pi, "oriClassType").getInt(inst)
                            line("  oriInstrumentation = " +
                                (ori?.javaClass?.name ?: "null") + " oriClassType = " + typ)
                        } catch (e: Throwable) {
                            line("  ori: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e: Throwable) {
                    line("ProxyInstrumentation.instance: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
                }
            }
            // per-Activity instrumentation (registerActivity's target)
            try {
                val actsAny = fieldOf(atCls, "mActivities").get(at)
                if (actsAny == null) {
                    line("mActivities = null")
                } else {
                    val entries = actsAny.javaClass.getMethod("entrySet")
                        .invoke(actsAny) as java.util.Set<*>
                    line("mActivities.size = " + entries.size)
                    for (entry in entries) {
                        if (entry == null) continue
                        val rec = entry.javaClass.getMethod("getValue")
                            .invoke(entry) ?: continue
                        val act = fieldOf(rec.javaClass, "activity").get(rec) ?: continue
                        val ai = try {
                            fieldOf(Class.forName("android.app.Activity"),
                                "mInstrumentation").get(act)
                        } catch (e: Throwable) {
                            null
                        }
                        line("  activity " + act.javaClass.name +
                            " mInstrumentation = " + (ai?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("mActivities: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
            }
            // v36 anchor A: framework provider map — did the framework
            // install any providers itself (the engine installs the
            // guest's manually; anything here came via the framework)?
            try {
                val pmAny = fieldOf(atCls, "mProviderMap").get(at)
                if (pmAny == null) {
                    line("mProviderMap = null")
                } else {
                    val entries = pmAny.javaClass.getMethod("entrySet")
                        .invoke(pmAny) as java.util.Set<*>
                    line("mProviderMap.size = " + entries.size)
                    for (entry in entries) {
                        if (entry == null) continue
                        val rec = entry.javaClass.getMethod("getValue")
                            .invoke(entry) ?: continue
                        val local = try {
                            fieldOf(rec.javaClass, "mLocalProvider").get(rec)
                        } catch (e: Throwable) {
                            null
                        }
                        line("  provider local=" +
                            (local?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("mProviderMap: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
            }
            // v36 anchor B: is the FPSDK native lib even loaded in
            // this process? fetchDeviceId cannot have run otherwise.
            // (libDexHelper as a positive control — it always loads.)
            try {
                val maps = java.io.File("/proc/self/maps").readText()
                line("maps libUnicomFPSDK.so loaded = " +
                    maps.contains("libUnicomFPSDK"))
                line("maps libDexHelper.so loaded = " +
                    maps.contains("libDexHelper"))
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("maps: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            line("sample failed: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + "> " + e.message)
        }
        try {
            out.appendText(sb.toString())
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        }
    }

    private fun unwrapHijackProxy(out: java.io.File, label: String) {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        fun line(s: String) {
            sb.append(s).append('\n')
            Timber.tag("HijackTrace").i("%s unwrap: %s", label, s)
        }
        if (stockInitExperiment) {
            line("skipped, v35 stock-init experiment active")
            try { out.appendText(sb.toString()) } catch (_: Throwable) { }
            return
        }
        if (!UNWRAP_ENABLED) {
            line("unwrap disabled (v36 observe-only baseline)")
            try { out.appendText(sb.toString()) } catch (_: Throwable) { }
            return
        }
        try {
            val atCls = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
            val at = atCls.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
            if (at == null) {
                line("skip, ActivityThread null")
                out.appendText(sb.toString())
                return
            }
            val instrF = fieldOf(atCls, "mInstrumentation")
            val cur = instrF.get(at)
            if (cur == null ||
                cur.javaClass.name != "com.sdk.hijack.base.ProxyInstrumentation"
            ) {
                line("skip, AT.mInstrumentation = " + (cur?.javaClass?.name ?: "null"))
                out.appendText(sb.toString())
                return
            }
            val ori = fieldOf(cur.javaClass, "oriInstrumentation").get(cur)
            if (ori == null) {
                line("abort, oriInstrumentation is null")
                out.appendText(sb.toString())
                return
            }
            instrF.set(at, ori)
            line("AT.mInstrumentation ProxyInstrumentation -> " + ori.javaClass.name)
            try {
                val actsAny = fieldOf(atCls, "mActivities").get(at)
                val entries = actsAny.javaClass.getMethod("entrySet")
                    .invoke(actsAny) as java.util.Set<*>
                val aiF = fieldOf(Class.forName("android.app.Activity"),
                    "mInstrumentation")
                for (entry in entries) {
                    if (entry == null) continue
                    val rec = entry.javaClass.getMethod("getValue")
                        .invoke(entry) ?: continue
                    val act = fieldOf(rec.javaClass, "activity").get(rec) ?: continue
                    val ai = aiF.get(act)
                    if (ai != null && ai.javaClass.name ==
                        "com.sdk.hijack.base.ProxyInstrumentation"
                    ) {
                        aiF.set(act, ori)
                        line("activity " + act.javaClass.name +
                            " mInstrumentation -> ori")
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                line("activities swap: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + ">")
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            line("unwrap failed: <" + e.javaClass.simpleName + "> " + e.message)
        }
        try {
            out.appendText(sb.toString())
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        }
    }

    /**
     * Framework-native bind (B2): build the guest's app ContextImpl
     * from its framework LoadedApk and let LoadedApk.makeApplication()
     * create + attach the Application — the same construction a real
     * app goes through in ActivityThread.handleBindApplication().
     *
     * The legacy path instead instantiates the Application by
     * reflection and attaches it to a VirtualContext whose underlying
     * LoadedApk is the HOST's (with guest paths patched into it). Any
     * code inspecting the Application's LoadedApk/ContextImpl object
     * graph (packers do) sees the seam. Here mLoadedApk, the resources,
     * the data dirs and the class loader are all genuinely the guest's
     * own framework objects.
     *
     * Providers and onCreate keep the same ordering as the legacy path.
     * Returns null if the framework construction fails; the caller
     * then falls back to the legacy bind.
     */
    private fun bindViaFrameworkLoadedApk(
        instanceId: String,
        packageName: String,
        loadedApk: Any,
        virtualContext: Context,
        providerNames: List<String>,
        providerAuthorities: Map<String, String>,
        providerMetaData: Map<String, Bundle> = emptyMap()
    ): Application? {
        var prevInstr: Instrumentation? = null
        return try {
            val atClass = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
            val activityThread = atClass.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
                ?: return null
            val loadedApkClass = Class.forName("android.app.LoadedApk")

            // Identity toward the real system must be the HOST's.
            // The framework LoadedApk carries the guest package in
            // mPackageName, and every ContextImpl created from it
            // derives mOpPackageName + mAttributionSource from that
            // field — so the guest's first Settings/DeviceConfig
            // provider call reaches the system with the guest package
            // as calling identity and dies on
            // AppOpsManager.checkPackage (guest pkg does not belong
            // to the host uid) with a SecurityException. Mirror the
            // LoadedApk-clone path's defense (see ActivityThreadHook):
            // patch mPackageName to the host package BEFORE any
            // ContextImpl is created from this LoadedApk. The
            // LoadedApk stays registered under the guest name in
```
